name: AWS shared credentials file entry
description: A profile section of the AWS shared credentials (or config) file: the aws_access_key_id, aws_secret_access_key and aws_session_token settings and the reference settings (credential_process, source_profile, role_arn) that name where credentials come from instead of holding them.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. A structured ini file. The secret access key and temporary key shapes are the existing aws:iam-user-secret-access-key and aws:sts-temporary-access-key families; this family records the file-level layout (profiles, which settings hold values, which hold references) and does not re-review those formats.
